phase_prompt.label: Phase 2
phase_prompt.summary: Addition of crystalline conduits, glowing glyphs, and bronze machinery
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Show the Abay complex after technological integration: crystalline conduits weave through stone arches, emitting a soft blue glow; glyphs on the walls pulse brighter; bronze and copper gears and pistons are visible beneath the stone, humming softly, while the river’s bioluminescent algae begin to shimmer.
